title: FlashControl: One-Step Controllable Generator via Distillation-Friendly Single-Stream Teachers
title_zh: FlashControl：基于蒸馏友好单流教师的单步可控生成器

paragraphs.en: 总结：FlashControl通过单流教师模型与步蒸馏技术，实现单步前向即可完成空间可控生成的高效模型。 Diffusion models have become a leading approach in visual generative modeling, particularly effective in text-to-image and controllable generation. Their main drawback is slow inference as it requires many sampling steps. While recent distillation methods enable one-step text-to-image generation, extending these techniques to controllable generation is still challenging. Existing controllable models, such as ControlNet, rely on dual-branch design that make distillation difficult. In this work, we adopt a simpler strategy. Instead of adding extra conditional branches, we finetune a selected subset of layers in the original text-to-image diffusion model to directly enable controllable generation. This results in DeltaControl, a single-flow, multi-step diffusion model capable of supporting spatial-condition generation while matching the performance of dual-branch approaches. Building on this teacher model, we further apply step-distillation to obtain FlashControl, a one-step model capable of spatial controllable generation with a single forward pass.
paragraphs.zh: 总结：FlashControl通过单流教师模型与步蒸馏技术，实现单步前向即可完成空间可控生成的高效模型。 扩散模型已成为视觉生成建模的主流方法，在文本到图像和可控生成方面尤为有效。 其主要缺点是推理速度慢，因为需要许多采样步骤。 尽管近期的蒸馏方法已能实现单步文本到图像生成，但将这些技术扩展到可控生成仍然具有挑战性。 现有的可控模型（如ControlNet）依赖于双分支设计，这使得蒸馏变得困难。 在本工作中，我们采用了一种更简单的策略。 我们不添加额外的条件分支，而是对原始文本到图像扩散模型中所选定的一部分层进行微调，以直接实现可控生成。 由此得到DeltaControl，一个单流、多步的扩散模型，能够支持空间条件生成，同时达到与双分支方法相当的性能。 在这一教师模型的基础上，我们进一步应用步蒸馏，得到FlashControl，一个仅需单次前向传播即可实现空间可控生成的单步模型。
